annotations.title: Rank states by nursing home supply, quality, ownership or HUD 232

description: Ranks the states, DC, PR and GU on one nursing home measure: facilities, beds, median occupancy, nurse or RN hours, staff turnover, for-profit or chain share, PE or REIT owner flags, recent ownership changes, Special Focus count, or HUD 232 activity (active loans, balance, endorsements). Returns value, rank and state page.

order.description: desc = largest first (default), asc = smallest first.
